content: Angketj Altjerreng petjek
Angketj rang anganentj kwet anek. Angketj rang Altjerrel-ayel anek. Angketj rang Altjerr anek.
Angketj rang Altjerrel-ayel anek anganentj.

Angketj nhenhel-ayel Altjerrel ahelh-arlk alker-arlk tjerrtj-arlk ingkerrek arrmernek. Angketj rang iteth anthek ingkerrekeh. Iteth rang parrtj anek. Parrtj nhenh ngwemerntel parrtjelh-ilek tjerrtjeh kwetant. Ngwemerntel parrtj renh ywarn ilwernem.
Altjerrel artwang nyent tjerrtj map-warn lanthek, artwang nhenh kwerenh arreny anek John.
John rang tjerrtj map-warn alhek, inenh parrtj nhenh kwer-penh iletjeh. Kwereng inang parrtj kwer-penh awemeng, inang Altjerr renh naketjenheng.
John rang kwenh itja parrtjentj-akert anek. Rang tjerrtj map parrtj kwer-penh ilekant war.
Rang inenh lakenh ilek, “Parrtj anthwerr rang, nheng tjerrtj ingkerrek parrtjelh-iletjenh, rang ahelh nhenh-warn petjetjenh.”
Altjerr-henh angketj mpwerrk-akertemehngwerrm-irrek
Angketj rang ahelhel anek. Tjerrtj inang angketj renh itja alhengk-arek, rang inehel-arleng anetjam. Angketj rang ahelh nhenh arrmernekarl!
Angketj rang tjerrtj arlaltj kwerenh map-warn petjek, inang kwer ahentj-kwenyarl anek.
Kenh tjerrtj inang angketj renh alhengk-aremel nakek, angketj rang inenh ilek, “Arrantherr Altjerr-henh peltjemeh anem.”

Tjerrtj inang Altjerreh peltj-irrek, Altjerr rarrp ahentj-anek-arleng wart, inang peltj kwerenh anetjeh. Inang itja iterrentj inehenh-akert nhenh mpwarek, Altjerrelant inenh twer angerr-akertel peltj-ilek.

Angketj rangemeh ngwerrm-irrek, nwernehel-ayeng anerl-alpek. Nwern renh arek, alkereng parrtj angerr-akert, Angey-henh Ler nyentant anemeng. Rang arratj anthwerr anek, nyerrkentj mernelhemel ahelh nhenh-warn petjek.

John-el tjerrtj map arlkemel ilek, “Nhenh kwenh artwang rang, kwer-penh thang nheng arrantherrenh arrwekel ilekarl, ‘Artwang rang tjengeng ingkern petjem. Rang anek tjeng-kwenyel-amparr. Lakenh rang kwenh tjengeng angerr anthwerr anem.’
Rang nyerrkentj anthwerr anem, rang nwerneh ingkerrekeh nyerrkentj mernelhem kwetant.

Altjerrel arrwekel nheng tjerrtj mapeh mpwareng-areng kwerenh ilek Moses-el-ayeng, rang ingkernemeh nwerneh Jesu Christ-el-ayeng kangkentj kwet mernelhek, rang nwernenh angketj arratj renh ilek Jesu Christ-el-ayeng.
Tjerrtj nyentel itja kwet Altjerr renh arek apek. Kel Ler nyent kwerenhelant renh arek, rang kwerel-ayeng kwet anemeng. Rant Altjerr nwerneh mernek.”
John Kwatjeh Irrpelh-ilenh-ilenh ilelhek

Tjerrtj Jew twernk map inang town Jerusalem-el anetjam, inang priest rrpwetj thwen church angerretj-henh rrkwapenh-apenh rrpwetj thwen John-warn lanthek. Inang renh pawenherrerrek, “Ngwenham ntwang? Nthenh-arenyam ntwang?”
John rang tjernemel ilelhek, “Yeng itja Christ rang anem, Altjerrel ngkwey alhelekarl.”

Inang renh wetharlam pawenherrerrek, “Ngwenham ntwang? Ntwang Altjerr-henh angketj angenh-angenh Elijah nheng key?” Rang tjernemel ilelhek, “Yeng itja Elijah.” Inang renh pawenherrerrek wetharlam, “Ntwam Altjerr-henh angketj angenh-angenh nheng key, ngkweyeny alhelekarl-penh?” Rang tjernemel ilelhek, “Itjaw!”
Inang renh wethemeharlam pawenhek, “Ngwenham ntwang? Kwewaleny ilelhay! Artwang nhak map, nthakenham nwern inenh iletjenh?”

John-el inenh angketj angenh-angenh Isaiah-henh angketjel ilek, “Yeng kwenh tjerrtj rrkwal-arenyarl, thang arrantherrenh ateng-ilemel ilerl-apem, ‘Ngkarteh arrwekel tjey mpwarewarrangaw!’ Angketj tjengenh alhengk-arerrerray!”
Artwang Pharisee rrpwetj twernk inehenhel lanthek,

inang renh ilek, “Ntwang ilelhek, ntwang itja Christ rang anem, itja Elijah apek, itja Altjerr-henh angketj angenh-angenh arrpenh nheng Moses-arl anek-arteh apek. Wenheham ntwang tjerrtj map kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilem? Yanh itja arratj anem, lakenh mpwaretjeh!”
John rang ilelhek, “Thang tjerrtj kwatjel war irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-ilem. Artwang nyent kel ahelh nhenhel anem, arrantherr kwer akwenarl anem.
Rang kwenh tjengeng ingkern petjem. Yeng itja rarteh anem. Rang mwerr anthwerr anem. Yeng anetj-anetj war, pwet kwerenh kap-rlwetjeh apek.”
Lakenh John rang ilelhek, rang tjerrtj map kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-iletjart-penh, mer Bethany-el Jordan ulpayeng ingerr-angkwerr.
Altjerr-henh yep-yep nyerrkentj rang

Arltang arrpenhel John-el Jesu renh arek, ularr kwer-warn petjerleh. Rang tjerrtj map ilek, “Arerrerrang, artwang nhenh kwenh Altjerr-henh Yep-yep kwek rang. Rang tjerrtj map-henh anetj rrpwaremel wem.

Artwang nhenh thang arrantherrenh arrwekel-antey ilek, ‘Artwang rang kwenh tjeng ingkerneng petjetjenh, rang tjengeng arrwekel-antey anek tjeng-kwenyel-amparr. Lakenheng rang tjengeng inangkal-lkwer anem.’
Thang renh itja alhengk-arek arrwekel, lyetan thang renh alhengk-arem. Yeng kwenh petjekarl, arrantherrenh kwatjel-ayel baptise-em-iletjeh, kelant arrantherr renh alhengk-aremel aretjenh.”
John-el inenh Jesu kwer-penh ilek, “Thang Kwerrern renh arek, alkereng kwer-warn thep ntwerrert-arteh arrernelhetj-alhemeng kwerel-ayeng kwetemeh irrek.

Thang renh itja-amparr alhengk-arek. Altjerrel yengenh lanthek, tjerrtj map kwatj-warn irrpelh-ilemel baptise-em-iletjenh. Rang yengenh lakenh ilek, ‘Ntwang aretjenh Kwerrern rang artwang ngwenheh apek arrernelhetj-alherleh, ntwang renh alhengk-aretjenh, Christ rang anem. Artwang nhenhel tjerrtj map Kwerrern Alngaltarel baptise-em-iletjenh.’
Thang renh alhengk-arekemeh. Thang arrantherrenh ilem, artwang nhenh rang Altjerr-henh Ler anemeng.”
Jesu-el Peter Andrew kenheng-atherr ngwek,kwertengerl anetjeh
Arltang arrpenhel John rang mer Bethany-el anetjam, ulpay Jordan-eng ingerr, kwertengerl kwerenh atherr-akert.
John-el Jesu talkw alherleh rtwarek. Rang renh aremel angkek, “Artwang nhak arerl-anerray! Rang kwenh Yep-yep Altjerr-henh anem!”
Kwertengerl ratherr John renh awek, rang lakenh angkemeng. Ratherr John imperl-alhemel Jesu-eng ingkern-angkwerr alherrek.

Jesu-el alngarelhemel renh-atherrenh arek, kwereng ingkerneng petj-alherremeng. Rang renh-atherrenh pawenhek, “Wenham mpwel ahentj-irrem?” Ratherr angkek, “Rabbi! Mer nthenhel ntwang anem?” (Rabbi Anmatjerr angketjel angart-wem kaltj-anthenh-anthenh.)
Rang renh-atherrenh ilek, “Aretjeh petj-alherray!” Ratherr kwerel-ayeng alhek mer kwerenh-warn. Ratherr kwerel-ayeng antarl-irrek angway-angwayek-atwetj.
Kwertengerl atherreng nyent anek Andrew, Simon Peter-henh tjey.

Kweny-rtwehemeh Andrew rang parrp alhek, kekw kwerenh Simon-eh palenthwetjeh. Rang renh aretj-alhemel ilek, “Nwern Messiah renh arek!” Hebrew angketjel renh ilem Messiah. Angketj arrpenh mapel renh anewem Christ. Christ renh Altjerrel ngkwey alhelek, renh Israel-areny map-warn lanthetjeh.

Andrew rang kekw kwerenh Jesu-warn ngwerl-alpek. Jesu-el Simon renh rtwant anthwerr arek. Rang renh ilek, “Ntwang kwenh arreny Simon, ntwang John-henh ler anem. Thang ngwenh arreny Cephas ilem.” Cephas angketj arrpenhel anewem Peter.
Jesu-el Philip Nathanael atherr ngwek,kwertengerl kwerenh anetjeh
Arltang arrpenhel Jesu rang ahentj-anek mer Galilee-warn alhetjeh. Rang alherl-apemel Philip renh arek. Rang renh ngwek, “Petj-alhay tjengel-arleng.”
Philip rang mer Bethsaida-areny anek. Andrew Peter kenheng atherr mer alenh kwer-areny-antey anek.

Philip Nathanael-eh palenthwek. Rang renh aretj-alhemel pawenhek, “Ntwang irlpangkem key, artwang nheng-penh Moses-el Altjerr-kenh angketj angenh-angenh mapel thwen pip-warn arrernekarleh? Nwern renh arek. Arreny rang anem Jesu, Joseph-henh ler, Nazareth-areny.”
Nathanael-el tjweker-irremel renh pawenhek, “Nazareth-areny key artwang mwerr anem? Itja apek!” Philip-el renh ilek, “Kel aretjehant petjay!”
Jesu-el Nathanael renh arnarek ularr petjerleh. Rang artwang nhenh kwer-penh angkek, “Artwang nhenh kwenh Israel-kenh peltj anem. Rang artwang irlpareth anem. Artwang arratj.”

Nathanael-el renh pawenhek, “Nthakenharl ntwang tjeng kaltj anek?” Jesu-el renh ilek, “Thang ngwenh arrwekel kwet arek, ntwang arnang tjwerrkel-ayeng lywel anemeng. Philip-el ngwenh ngwetj-kwenyeng-antey.”
Nathanael-el renh ilek, “Kaltj-anthenh-anthenhay! Ntwang kwenh Altjerr-henh Ler rang anem, mer Israel-ek king!”
Jesu-el renh ilek, “Ntwang kwenh yengenh nakem, thang ngwenh ilek-arleng, thang ngwenh arekarl, arnang tjwerrkel-ayeng lywel anerleh. Kelant ntwang aretjenh, thang twer angerr tjengenh mernetjenh.

Thang ngwenh arratj ilem, arrantherr alker renh aretjenh altjwer-irrerleh, angel alker-areny aretjenh, Tjerrtj-henh Ler kwer-warn anarnpetj-alherleh. Kwereng arrantherr aretjenh, inang alker-warn angkep alperleh.”

footnotes.text: Keth-ilentj:  Yep-yep kwek rang. Rang tjerrtj ingkerrek-henh anetj angem. Arrwekeleny map inang yep-yep kwek atwetjart. Yep-yep kwek rarteh alkereng petjekarl. Iteth kwerenh rang mentj anthelhek. Lakenh John rang ilek.
